_readme: NOMOS-SPEC-008 rev. 0.9.0 vectors: intake questions (data_contract.gates) answered in an Act. Verify each case's act as for vectors.json; a case's local_facts, when present, replace the file's. Compare every field `expected` names.

cases.name: questions_unanswered
cases.note: Nothing answered: the rules that could deny are open, and the result names the questions that would settle them.

meta.description: SPEC-008 rev. 0.9.0 test vector authority: a law decided through intake questions.

workflow.intent: Synthetic baseline for automated consumer loan decisions.

assumptions: Synthetic baseline reflecting common industry practice, not a specific organisation’s policy (confidence band DECLARED, NOMOS-SPEC-001 §5.2).
Evaluation model deny_list: when no decision matches, the action is permitted; when the request carries none of the evaluated fields, it is escalated.
